title: Pipedream alternatives as Workflows close | 50agents
description: Pipedream Workflows are closing. Move code-heavy workflows to n8n or Activepieces, simpler ones to Zapier, Make or 50agents. What each suits and its price.
answer: Code-heavy workflows fit n8n or Activepieces, which both self-host.
Simpler ones fit Zapier or Make, and 50agents rebuilds a workflow from one sentence, such as Stripe payments into a Google Sheet.
ask: Set up an automation: every new Stripe payment is added as a row to my Google Sheet with the customer, amount and date
lede: Where Pipedream workflows can go, side by side.

notice.body: Pipedream says Workflows and String are shutting down on March 31, 2027. Pipedream now sells Connect, an integration layer for developers.

strengths.title: Automations on events
strengths.line: The same steps on a new order, payment or contact, or on a timer.

strengths.title: Describe it in plain words
strengths.line: Captain asks a few questions, shows a plan, then builds it.

strengths.title: You see every step
strengths.line: Captain shows the plan before it builds, and every step after.

move.title: Export each project
move.body: Projects export as a ZIP of workflow JSON files, with credentials removed.

move.title: Sort code from simple
move.body: Workflows full of code go to n8n; simple app-to-app ones can come here.

move.title: Rebuild a simple one
move.body: Tell Captain what it does in one sentence, like Stripe payments into a sheet.

move.title: Reconnect your accounts
move.body: Credentials are not exported, so connect each app again.

faqs.a: Pipedream says Workflows and String are shutting down. Pipedream continues as Connect, an integration layer for developers.

faqs.q: What is the closest alternative to Pipedream?
faqs.a: For code steps, n8n: it has a code node in JavaScript or Python and can run on your own servers.

faqs.q: Can I import Pipedream workflows into another tool?
faqs.a: Not directly. The export is a ZIP of JSON files without credentials. Use it as your checklist and rebuild.
